description: Line chart that draws itself in time with the video: up to 3 lines, each point timed in seconds from the item's start. Hand-drawn SVG, so the preview, the export and sample_frame match.

props.name: values
props.description: Comma list (or JSON array) of y values, spread evenly over the item's length

props.name: points
props.description: JSON array of [t, y] pairs, t in seconds from the item's start; replaces values

props.name: series
props.description: JSON array of up to 3 lines: { name, color, points or values }; replaces points, values and lineColor

props.name: xFrom
props.description: x axis label at the start, in the data's own units (with xTo); empty labels seconds

props.name: xTo
props.description: x axis label at the end, in the data's own units (with xFrom)

props.name: yMin
props.description: Bottom of the y range; empty fits the data

props.name: yMax
props.description: Top of the y range; empty fits the data

props.name: bgColor
props.description: Any colour draws a rounded card behind the chart

props.name: fill
props.description: A soft area under a single line

props.name: showValue
props.description: The value at the tip, single line only
